candidate_datasets.name: Bad News / ConPro Online Ads Dataset
candidate_datasets.paper_title: Bad News: Clickbait and Deceptive Ads on News and Misinformation Websites (ConPro 2020)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Study clickbait, deceptive advertorials, and problematic ads running across mainstream and misinformation news sites.
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Ad moderation component targeting deceptive claims, financial scams, misleading health supplements, and deceptive native clickbait. Samples with 'Potentially Unwanted Software' and deceptive scams align with UNSAFE_FOR_ALL; financial/mortgage/investing advertorials align with adult/SAFE_18_PLUS, while generic products remain unassigned.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Open GitHub repository for code and dataset.csv (2,246 ad annotations). Screenshots archive (~multi-GB) is hosted on Google Drive (link provided in README).
candidate_datasets.license_status: Research / Academic Use Only (ConPro 2020 publication; no explicit permissive open source license file)
candidate_datasets.commercial_restrictions: Non-commercial academic research only; no commercial grant.
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Cite paper: 'Bad News: Clickbait and Deceptive Ads on News and Misinformation Websites', Eric Zeng et al., IEEE ConPro 2020.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Download dataset.csv and metadata from GitHub: https://github.com/eric-zeng/conpro-bad-ads-data
2. Download screenshots archive from Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/12sCuxv38RPlrRKUs-hjl-JrTDQ4J_HcR/view?usp=sharing
3. Extract screenshots into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/conpro_bad_ads/screenshots/
4. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source conpro_bad_ads --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/conpro_bad_ads
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Ad screenshots collected in Jan 2020; some external landing page URLs are expired; annotations reflect qualitative editorial codebook rather than age moderation tiers.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Live GitHub repository active, dataset.csv confirmed with 2,246 entries).

candidate_datasets.name: Facebook Hateful Memes (FHM)
candidate_datasets.paper_title: The Hateful Memes Challenge: Detecting Hate Speech in Multimodal Memes (NeurIPS 2020)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Benchmark multimodal vision-and-language models on detecting hateful memes featuring benign unimodal confounders.
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Multimodal fusion submodule for detecting hateful imagery and derogatory overlaid text in visual advertisement creatives. Hateful samples map to UNSAFE_FOR_ALL, while benign samples remain unassigned for ad classification.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Restricted / Gated Access. Requires registering on DrivenData (Competition 73) or signing the Meta research license agreement via Hugging Face ('facebook/hateful_memes').
candidate_datasets.license_status: Meta Hateful Memes Research License (Non-commercial research only, privacy restrictions, Getty Images compilation restrictions)
candidate_datasets.commercial_restrictions: Strictly Non-Commercial. Commercial use is prohibited.
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Must cite Kiela et al. (NeurIPS 2020); images containing third-party stock assets require proper copyright notice (© Getty Images).
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Register at DrivenData (https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/73/hateful-memes/) or accept terms on Hugging Face (facebook/hateful_memes).
2. Download train.jsonl, dev_seen.jsonl, and image archive.
3. Place into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/hateful_memes/.
4. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source hateful_memes --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/hateful_memes
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Contains offensive and hateful material; images are internet memes rather than commercial ads; binary hate label does not map 1:1 to general advertising appropriateness.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Competition terms and Hugging Face gated card verified; manual authentication required).

candidate_datasets.name: DeHate Video Dataset
candidate_datasets.paper_title: DeHate: A Holistic Hateful Video Dataset for Explicit and Implicit Hate Detection (ACM MM 2025)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Provide a comprehensive video dataset for explicit and implicit hate speech detection with fine-grained temporal segment annotations across TikTok and BitChute.
actual_label_types: Target Groups: Race, Gender, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Disability, Immigration
Modality Attribution: Text only, Visual only, Audio only, Visual+Audio, Visual+Text, Text+Audio, Visual+Audio+Text
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Direct video-level safety moderation in SafeAd SAFE-VISION pipeline, specifically temporal localization of hateful violations and multimodal video-audio fusion. Explicit hate video segments map to UNSAFE_FOR_ALL; non-hate video clips remain unassigned.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Open GitHub repo contains DeHate.xlsx (6,689 annotated video entries). Video clips must be fetched via platform IDs or requested from authors in compliance with platform terms of service.
candidate_datasets.license_status: Academic Research Use Only (Strict Ethics Statement; confidential research use only; no permissive redistribution of raw platform videos)
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Cite ACM MM 2025 paper: 'DeHate: A Holistic Hateful Video Dataset for Explicit and Implicit Hate Detection'.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Clone or download annotations from: https://github.com/Multimodal-Intelligence-Lab-MIL/DeHate
2. Download DeHate.xlsx.
3. Download platform video clips using author-provided scripts or authorized credentials.
4. Place clips into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/dehate_video/videos/
5. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source dehate --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/dehate_video
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Short-form user-generated video content rather than commercial ads; some TikTok/BitChute source links may experience link rot; non-hate videos may contain adult or gambling content not covered by hate annotations.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Live GitHub repository active, DeHate.xlsx confirmed with 6,689 annotations).

candidate_datasets.name: Jigsaw Multilingual / Toxic Comment Classification
candidate_datasets.paper_title: Toxic Comment Classification Challenge / Multilingual Toxic Comment Classification (Jigsaw / Google)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Identify and classify various forms of toxicity in online comments across multiple languages to improve conversation health.
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Textual safety analysis component for SafeAd: moderation of ad voiceover transcripts (ASR), video captions, and OCR visual text. Samples flagged with severe_toxic, threat, or identity_hate map to UNSAFE_FOR_ALL; obscene maps to SAFE_18_PLUS or UNSAFE_FOR_ALL; clean text alone cannot assign SAFE_FOR_ALL without visual confirmation.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Kaggle account required to accept competition rules; also mirrored under TensorFlow Datasets and Hugging Face ('jigsaw_toxicity_pred').
candidate_datasets.license_status: CC0 (Public Domain) for Jigsaw annotations; underlying Wikipedia talk page comments licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0
candidate_datasets.commercial_restrictions: Permissive (CC0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 allow commercial and non-commercial usage with appropriate attribution).
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Attribution to Jigsaw / Conversation AI and Wikipedia contributors per CC BY-SA 3.0.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Accept competition rules on Kaggle (https://www.kaggle.com/c/jigsaw-multilingual-toxic-comment-classification/rules).
2. Download using Kaggle CLI: kaggle competitions download -c jigsaw-multilingual-toxic-comment-classification
3. Extract train.csv into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/jigsaw_toxic/
4. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source jigsaw_toxic --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/jigsaw_toxic
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Text-only dataset; no visual ad banners or video assets; high proportion of conversational insults rather than promotional ad copy.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Kaggle dataset and CC0/CC-BY-SA terms verified).

candidate_datasets.name: UTKFace Large-Scale Face Dataset
candidate_datasets.paper_title: UTKFace: Large Scale Face Dataset with Long Age Span (AICIP, University of Tennessee)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Benchmark face detection, age estimation, age progression/regression, and landmark localization.
actual_label_types: race/ethnicity (0: White, 1: Black, 2: Asian, 3: Indian, 4: Others)
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Core foundation for SafeAd's age-aware verification modules: training and evaluating the face-age estimation model (sooraj_face_age_core) to verify user feed age restrictions and detect minors in ad creative content. Individual face photos are NOT ads; therefore their SafeAd 4-tier ad classification must remain UNASSIGNED.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Open Google Drive links provided in official GitHub repository README (1.3GB in-the-wild, 107MB cropped faces, 12MB landmarks).
candidate_datasets.license_status: Non-commercial Research Purposes Only (AICIP does not hold image copyright; collected from web).
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Cite UTKFace GitHub repository (Zhang, Song, & Qi, AICIP, Univ. of Tennessee) in academic publications.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Visit official repository: https://github.com/aicip/UTKFace
2. Download UTKFace.tar.gz or aligned/cropped ZIP from Google Drive links in README.
3. Extract into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/utkface/faces/
4. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source utkface --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/utkface
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Single-face wild images; uneven age distribution (fewer elderly/infants); continuous age labels have human annotator noise; cannot be directly used as advertisement safety samples.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Live GitHub repository active, Google Drive download links verified).

candidate_datasets.name: FairFace Balanced Demographic Face Dataset
candidate_datasets.paper_title: FairFace: Face Attribute Dataset for Balanced Race, Gender, and Age for Bias Measurement and Mitigation (WACV 2021)
candidate_datasets.purpose: Mitigate demographic bias in facial analysis algorithms with a balanced dataset across race, gender, and age.
actual_label_types: race (7 groups: White, Black, Indian, East Asian, Southeast Asian, Middle Eastern, Latino_Hispanic)
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Fairness auditing and demographic debiasing of SafeAd face-age classifier. Validates that age estimation works equitably across diverse demographic groups for teen (10-19) and adult (20+) boundary checks. Individual face crops are NOT ads; their SafeAd 4-tier ad classification must remain UNASSIGNED.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Public GitHub repository (dchen236/FairFace and joojs/fairface) with Google Drive download links for images (train/val archive) and label CSV files.
candidate_datasets.commercial_restrictions: Permissive (Commercial use permitted with attribution per CC BY 4.0 terms).
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Must cite Karkkainen & Joo (WACV 2021): 'FairFace: Face Attribute Dataset for Balanced Race, Gender, and Age for Bias Measurement and Mitigation'.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions:
1. Visit official GitHub: https://github.com/joojs/fairface or https://github.com/dchen236/FairFace
2. Download fairface_label_train.csv and fairface-img-margin125-trainval.zip from Google Drive.
3. Extract into SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/fairface/
4. Run importer tool: python tools/importer.py --source fairface --data-dir SafeAd_Dataset/existing_datasets/fairface
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Cropped facial images only; discrete age brackets rather than exact continuous ages; strictly for facial analysis, not advertisement creative evaluation.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (WACV 2021 published, CC BY 4.0 license verified).

candidate_datasets.name: Beer TV Ads Dataset
candidate_datasets.paper_title: Beer TV Ads Open Archive & Multimodal Commercials Collection
candidate_datasets.purpose: Study television broadcast advertisements, brand creative messaging, and beverage commercial media.
candidate_datasets.potential_safead_use: Direct video ad policy classification for SAFE_18_PLUS (Alcohol and Beverage Advertising Regulations). Real broadcast commercials with brand, dialogue/audio, and visual product presentations.
candidate_datasets.access_requirements: Open Hugging Face dataset (dnaoblivion/Beer-Tv-Ads) with high-speed direct CloudFront CDN video stream links.
candidate_datasets.license_status: Research / Open Broadcast (Commercial TV broadcasts archived for research and evaluation purposes)
candidate_datasets.attribution_requirements: Cite dnaoblivion/Beer-Tv-Ads repository on Hugging Face.
candidate_datasets.download_import_instructions: Run scripts/download_beer_video_ads.py --limit <N> to stream .mp4 files directly to D:\SafeAd_Dataset\existing_datasets\video_ads\videos\.
candidate_datasets.known_limitations: Commercials focus specifically on beer / alcohol category; historical broadcast archive; English language predominant.
candidate_datasets.verification_status: Verified (Live CloudFront CDN links verified, 75 broadcast videos ingested with streaming SHA-256 digests).
